extracted.name: Chicken Cacciatore with Rice
extracted.description: Quick and easy to make in just one pot, this chicken cacciatore recipe with rice features an aromatic mixture of vegetables and seasonings.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Add chicken, onion, and garlic; cook until chicken is browned and onion and garlic are softened, 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce, bell pepper, salt, basil, and cayenne pepper; bring to boil. Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in rice, cover, and remove from the heat. Let stand until rice is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir before serving.
